name: Independent Amount Term
definition: Defines the specific terms used to calculate an independent amount.

Convention.name: Convention
Convention.definition: Determines how the independent amount was applied in the calculation. ||It is either:||- Before threshold, effectively acting as an add on to exposure, ||- After threshold where the amount is an add on to the credit support amount and forms part of the variation margin requirement,||- Segregated where it is treated independently of variation margin for segregation purposes.Defines the specific terms used to calculate an independent amount.
